issues: Covers and spend per head down week on week, offset by the highest app discounts yet: 400 more 5 GBP ramens and 500 more free ramens.
Sales target raised by Matt from 62,000 to 67,500 GBP to match actual performance.
Labour 20.92%; food cost 25.6%, ordering being watched closely; food variance exactly 5.0%.
Google reviews: 13 five star ratings.
Onboarding: Caitlin's final Saturday shift before moving to London.
Compliance 100%, but no access to the compliance app for two weeks despite chasing Ross.
Maintenance: engineer fixed the glass wash leak; new heaters above the doors fitted by Chris; dangerous water boiler needs replacing.
Short of six chairs, hitting Saturday covers; up to four chairs to be transferred from Braehead.
Region: food spend target temporarily raised to 26% until current promotions end (Matthew Jenner).
Region: hats or hairnets mandatory for all staff to prevent food contamination.
Region: menu to be redesigned with spice levels built into all ramen dishes and free chillies removed.
Region: GM and HC meeting notes must run through Google Meet so Gemini takes the notes; budget router templates updated, Monday dates must be entered correctly.
Covers fell to 3,315, down 182 (5.49%) week on week but up 554 (20.07%) year on year.
Spend per head fell to £20.56, down £0.23 (1.11%) week on week and down £2.55 (11.03%) year on year.
Sales were £68,169.57, down £4,524.68 (6.22%) week on week and up £4,374.34 (6.85%) year on year, beating the new £67,500 target by £669.57 (0.99%); the BOH meeting sheet shows £68,123.36 (+0.92%).

Food cost rose to 25.60% from 24.69% the week before, which Yan Ha described as a little higher; Yan Ha reported a stable week with the hot kitchen and sushi section settled, and the site has no delivery service.
The site ordered frozen ramen last Sunday at 1.5 times the normal order, so extra storage is needed, particularly with the new broth also arriving.
May and Tobi are away until the end of the month, and Nabina is covering sushi this week while Fiona is away.
Kris could not repair the water boiler, which was spitting water from the bottom, so a new one has been ordered.
The missing chairs still have no ETA; Francheska said they were due in the country two weeks ago and now has no ETA.
Another sushi and sides incentive is planned to lift SPH after the team responded well to the one over the weekend.
XOXO, the Maki App and the frozen ramen student activation are the upcoming promotions.

Region: five of the nine Scotland and Newcastle sites ran food cost above 25% (Maki 12, 1, 7, 3 and 8), which the Scotland BOH meeting of 13/10 linked to loyalty programme and delivery platform discounts across the group.

Region: new tonkotsu and chicken broth arrives from 15/10 and needs no added water; defrost it a day ahead and reheat it in a pot rather than straight on the heat, and a digital Brix meter is arriving to replace checking by eye, though not every site has one yet (Scotland BOH meeting 13/10).

Region: new chicken arrives on 15/10 and the new char siu (different shape) and pre cooked frozen beef from 19/10, starting at Maki 8; defrost the beef a day ahead and grill or pan fry it for 15 seconds a side before slicing, holding extra stock because it cannot be used on the day it arrives (Scotland BOH meeting 13/10).

Region: the frozen ramen promotion is postponed by one week, and Penny is checking with Michael whether frozen ramen counts in food cost or separately, as some sites have already bought it (Scotland BOH meeting 13/10).

Top sellers were Steak Tataki Ramen (496, plus 50 halal), Black Garlic Tonkotsu (398) and Chicken Ramen (366); sea bream sashimi and steak nigiri sold once, and scallop, grilled steak and octopus nigiri twice.
The drinks target was hit but sushi and sides were not, and the £22 SPH target was missed with many £5 and free ramen vouchers used.
Wage revenue was on target after cuts, with a labour split of 43.86% FOH and 56.14% BOH against a 45% and 55% target.
Wet usage variance was minus 1.0%, within the acceptable range.
Site efficiency was amber at 93 (AM Updates 14/10).
SPH, sides sales and sushi cover are the stated areas for improvement.

Region: Ka Ho put food cost of 25.3% to 27.2% at Maki 1, Fountainbridge, M7, M8 and M12 down to promotions lifting usage while sales projections were not adjusted; Michael said site leaders can ask for food cost and wage budget increases (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: a level 8 Halloween ramen with a super spicy factory chilli paste is launching with a video; one bag per site, about a teaspoon per bowl (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: snooze out of stock items on both Deliverect and the POS, or the whole delivery order fails (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: wage revenue baseline is 21% with up to 2% leeway; drinks cost moves to management, food cost to head chefs, new OKRs due end of November (AM Updates 14/10).
